intros.text: Oh, hello there! It's good to see a friendly face around here. Could you bring me {amount}× {ingredient}?
Hey! I was just about to start cooking, but I'm missing something important. I need {amount}× {ingredient}.
Excuse me, traveler. I have a small request. Could you find {amount}× {ingredient} for me?
You look like someone who knows their way around. I could really use {amount}× {ingredient}.
Perfect timing! I need a bit of help. I'm looking for {amount}× {ingredient}.

outros.text: I really need this to keep things going here. I'd appreciate your help.
Without it, I won't be able to finish what I started. I'm counting on you.
It may not sound like much, but it's very important to me.
If you manage to find it, I'll make sure it's worth your time.
Let me know once you have it. I'll be waiting right here.

hints.text: close to the river beyond the hills
around the old mill outside the village
not far from the main road
in the surrounding area, if you look carefully
